title: Biota.blockchain (BioDAO.X) at 1 DNA Way
summary: A walkable bayfront campus at Genentech HQ, Oyster Point, South San Francisco. Five zones: therapy labs, DAO hall, multi-chain ledger, health data exchange, and biopharma agents hub, stitched by boardwalks over mudflat sloughs on San Francisco Bay.

buildings.name: Molecular Modeling Wing
buildings.use: AI compound optimization for ALS and Parkinson's targets

buildings.name: Rare Disease Wet Lab
buildings.use: Assay benches and cryo-storage for candidate compounds

buildings.name: Governance Chamber
buildings.use: Per-organization DAO voting, policy and resource allocation

buildings.name: Compliance Annex
buildings.use: Jurisdiction tracking and fraud-notification war room

buildings.name: Interoperability Spire
buildings.use: Cross-network relay nodes for Ethereum, Hyperledger, Polkadot, Cosmos

buildings.name: Consent Pavilion
buildings.use: SMS patient-consent intake and smart-contract access desks

buildings.name: Agents Nexus
buildings.use: Central hub linking biopharma agent roles

court.name: Consent & Verification Court
court.style: Sunken circular plaza ringed by four chain-light pylons
court.why_here: Sits between Data Exchange and Ledger, the physical handshake point where patient consent meets verified cross-chain records.

quests.title: Encrypt the Patient Record
steps: Collect SMS consent at the Consent Pavilion
Have Health Agent encrypt the record
Verify anchoring on the four chains at the Interoperability Spire

quests.title: Trace the Suspicious Transaction
steps: Flag anomaly on the threat heatmap
Escort the audit trail to Finance Agent
Draft a DAO fraud notification proposal

quests.title: Optimize a Rare-Disease Compound
steps: Accept the R&D routing task at the Nexus
Run molecular modeling in the Simulation Bay
Archive the candidate in the Cryo Vault

quests.title: Jurisdiction Compliance Sweep
steps: Review rules on the jurisdiction globe
Check access contracts in the Cipher Room
Log compliance sign-off with the Compliance Agent

quests.title: Cross-Zone Data Handshake
steps: Package trial findings in the Review Atrium
Verify at the Consent & Verification Court
Deliver results to Clinical Support Annex
